attributes.label: Layout
attributes.help: Grid keeps every item the same width. Masonry lets individual items span two columns.

attributes.label: Container width
attributes.help: Bootstrap container that wraps the grid. Fluid spans the full viewport width.

attributes.label: Columns
attributes.help: How many columns the grid shows on wide screens. Narrower viewports step down on their own, down to a single column below 576 pixels.

attributes.label: Item style
attributes.help: Passed on to the images: Full removes their padding.

attributes.label: Item size
attributes.help: Stored for compatibility. This block does not render the value — neither does the previous plugin.

attributes.label: Card size
attributes.help: Minimum height of every image tile: extra small 20vh, small 40vh, medium 60vh, large 80vh, extra large 100vh. Empty falls back to medium.

attributes.label: Media fit
attributes.help: How the media fills its container. The rendering reads each image's own Media fit field, not this one.

attributes.label: Media height
attributes.help: Maximum media height in pixels, used when Media fit is Set dimensions. The rendering reads each image's own Media height field, not this one.

attributes.label: Media width
attributes.help: Maximum media width in pixels, used when Media fit is Set dimensions. The rendering reads each image's own Media width field, not this one.

attributes.label: Media alignment
attributes.help: How the media sits inside its container. The rendering reads each image's own Media alignment field, not this one.

attributes.label: Media size
attributes.help: Stored for compatibility. This block does not render the value, and the previous plugin has no editor field for it either.

attributes.label: Image size
attributes.help: Registered image size the pictures are loaded at. The rendering reads each image's own Image size field, not this one.

attributes.label: Link to
attributes.help: Where a click on a picture leads. The rendering reads each image's own Link destination field, not this one.

attributes.label: Link target
attributes.help: Rendered as the target attribute of the link on every image in this grid. New tab writes target=_blank.

attributes.label: Crop images
attributes.help: Cropped thumbnails in the previous plugin's editor. Kept as stored data; neither plugin renders it.

attributes.label: Fixed height
attributes.help: Fixed image height in the previous plugin's editor. Kept as stored data; neither plugin renders it.

attributes.label: Allow resizing
attributes.help: Drag handles on the pictures in the previous plugin's editor. Kept as stored data; neither plugin renders it.

attributes.label: Show heading
attributes.help: Shows a heading above the grid. The heading text below is only rendered while this is on.

attributes.label: Heading level
attributes.help: HTML heading level of the heading above the grid.

attributes.label: Heading
attributes.help: Text of the heading above the grid. Basic inline HTML is allowed.

attributes.label: Heading color
attributes.help: Applies a Bootstrap text-color utility class to the heading.

attributes.label: Show intro
attributes.help: Turns on the block above the grid. The intro text is rendered as soon as it is filled and either this switch or Show heading is on — a quirk of the previous plugin, kept on purpose.

attributes.label: Intro
attributes.help: Text of the intro above the grid. Basic inline HTML is allowed.

attributes.label: Intro color
attributes.help: Applies a Bootstrap text-color utility class to the intro.

attributes.label: Show background
attributes.help: Turns on the background layer below — its color, overlay and alignment fields only take effect while this is on.

attributes.label: Background color
attributes.help: Only the rgb values are used for rendering. The remaining keys are kept for compatibility with the previous plugin.

attributes.label: Show overlay
attributes.help: Turns on the overlay layer, drawn above the background color. The overlay color below only takes effect while this is on.

attributes.label: Overlay color
attributes.help: Drawn as a layer above the background color. Like the background color, only the rgb values are used for rendering.

attributes.label: Horizontal background alignment
attributes.help: Aligns the background layer within its row when the background column width is narrower than the full row. Has no visible effect at full width.

attributes.label: Exclude pattern
attributes.help: Kept from the previous plugin. A pattern is only rendered when the filter crea_bootstrap_blocks_background_pattern supplies one.

attributes.label: Change pattern color
attributes.help: Kept from the previous plugin. This plugin hands the value to the pattern filter and renders nothing from it itself.

attributes.label: Pattern color
attributes.help: Color the previous plugin used for the background pattern. Handed to the pattern filter unchanged; this plugin renders nothing from it.

attributes.label: Background utilities
attributes.help: Stored for compatibility. This block does not render utility classes — neither does the previous plugin.

attributes.label: Text utilities
attributes.help: Stored for compatibility. This block does not render utility classes — neither does the previous plugin.

attributes.label: Border utilities
attributes.help: Stored for compatibility. This block does not render utility classes — neither does the previous plugin.

attributes.label: Exclude divider
attributes.help: Kept from the previous plugin. Only the Lightspeed theme evaluates it; this plugin stores the value and renders nothing from it.

attributes.label: Exclude transition
attributes.help: Kept from the previous plugin. Only the Lightspeed theme evaluates it; this plugin stores the value and renders nothing from it.

attributes.label: Exclude parallax
attributes.help: Kept from the previous plugin. Only the Lightspeed theme evaluates it; this plugin stores the value and renders nothing from it.

attributes.label: Block ID
attributes.help: Unique identifier of this block. It links the block to its generated inline CSS and must not be changed.
